tactics: rename_i α motive l₁ l₂ t F

rename_i α motive l₁ l₂ t F <;> exact (show ∀ a b (s : List.Sublist a b), List.Sublist.below s ∧ motive a b s from fun a b s => by induction s with | slnil => exact ⟨List.Sublist.below.slnil, F _ _ _ List.Sublist.below.slnil⟩ | cons x h ih => exact ⟨List.Sublist.below.cons x h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (List.Sublist.below.cons x h ih.1 ih.2)⟩ | cons₂ x h ih => exact ⟨List.Sublist.below.cons₂ x h ih.1 ih.2, F _ _ _ (List.Sublist.below.cons₂ x h ih.1 ih.2)⟩) l₁ l₂ t |>.2
